name: yousim
description: YouSim - Identity simulator. Run as CLI or server.
comment:deps: No RUNTIME dependencies, on purpose. `bun build --target bun` inlines
published package needs nothing at install time and there is no
workspace:* left in `dependencies` for someone else's npm to fail on.
They stay in devDependencies because that declaration is what makes bun
link the workspace members the bundle step resolves through - dropping it
leaves node_modules/@yousim empty and the build cannot resolve them.
npm keeps devDependencies in the packed manifest but never installs a
dependency's devDependencies, so they are inert for consumers.
